scores.evidence: Each of the three can-do objectives is assessed with objectiveId: o1 by q0, q1, q2, e1 and e2; o2 by q3, e3 and e4 (apply); o3 by q4, e5 and e6. o2 「書ける」 and o3 「設計できる」 (bloom create) are graded only by picking an option (e5 and e6 are evaluate). Writing and designing happen only in the self-checked practice (p1-checklist, p2-checklist).

hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「機能の実装を任せている途中で、急ぎのバグ修正を頼まれました…「毎晩、テストの失敗を報告してほしい」」) that leads into both halves of the lesson. The ungraded predict q0 targets misconception 1, every wrong option has feedback, and the answer is the third of four options.

prerequisites list 第2回, 4, 6, 7 and 8 plus Git, and the lesson recalls them where they apply: s1-lead 第7回, s3-mode 「Manualモード（第2回）」, s3-table 「フックやMCP（第8回）」, s4-enforce 「CLAUDE.mdと同じく」. Terms are defined at first use and match the glossary (s1-defs ワークツリー is word for word; s4-defs 無人実行 now equals the glossary entry). トークン, シェル and API are glossed at first use, and p-run now gives the reason for the key: 「`--bare` には、API…キーが必要です」.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 1583 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2654 · practice reading 1232 · questions 11 · practice sections 2 · est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. Each segment has one idea and at most 3 new terms. The lesson sits exactly at the 20-minute ceiling, and the unattended-where section (s4-defs, s4-table) is orientation that no question or practice uses.

s2-code with s2-steps is a full worked example with subgoal titles, the why of each step (「ワークツリーは既存のコミットから作ります」, 「ワークツリーには、Gitが管理するファイルしかありません」, 「消すと、ブランチごと消えます」) and an expect for each. s2-lead now makes it doable in the empty repo (「2つの作業を小さなファイルの追加に置き換えましょう」), and ex-setup's expect is conditional. s3-code models practice 1, but there is no faded step between the full example and independent work.

Every content segment except the orientation section unattended-where has an inline check (q1–q4), each with a hint. They include analyze and apply items, and answer positions vary. q1 now uses a new context (「ログイン画面の文言の修正と、決済の設定ファイルの変更」). q3's correct option, 「Manualモードで始まり、承認が必要な `npm test` が拒否される」, nearly repeats s3-mode 「Manualモード…で始まり、承認が要る操作は拒否されます」. q4's answer repeats s4-four item 4, so both can be answered partly by matching words.

All 7 misconceptions from the brief appear as distractors with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer that gives a reason. Examples: q3-c 「止まるのではなく、テストが動かないまま終わります」, e4-d 「`-p` は信頼の確認を出しません」, e5-d 「「更新なし」と区別できません」, and the new near-miss q4-d 「それでは、読めなかった日も同じ報告になります」. q2-b (「テストを実行できない」) and q4-c (cost cap) remain weaker filler distractors.

There are no images and no decoration. The three comparisons are 2-column tables whose captions state how to choose (s1-table 「誰がまとめるか、何に向くかで選ぶ」, s3-table 「安全な claude -p を作る5つのフラグ」). Not having a diagram is acceptable. The worktree folder and branch layout is the one structural idea that could use one.

Both tasks are authentic. Practice 1 is the hook's nightly check (`claude -p` with JSON output, predicted before running). Practice 2 audits a colleague's weak prompt, a transfer task for o3. Each has a hint → troubleshoot → model-answer ladder (p1-model; the p2-prompt expect) and a self-check checklist (pc-bare … pc-predict; pa-success … pa-flags).

The 4-point summary comes after the exam. summary-next gives a reflection task (「無人で回すときの成功の条件を1文で書いてみましょう」) and the next lesson. There are 7 retrieval flashcards, including card-quiet 「読めなかった日を「何もない日」と誤らないには？」, and 3 askTutor suggestions.

The three confirmed audit fixes are in: s1-lead 「並列の作業を助ける道具を2つ紹介します」, s3-table 「確認が要る操作を聞かずに拒否（読み取りは動く）」, and summary-points 「モードを指定しない `claude -p` は…」. Versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.302), the non-obvious claims cite official pages, and both code blocks run as written (the highlight lines match). I found no error I can back with evidence. One leftover from the audit's consistency note: the section title 「並列の3つの方法」 still says 方法.

The text is consistently です・ます, warm and non-pressuring (「大事なリポジトリでは試しません」, 「名前だけで十分です」), with no banned phrases. The permission prompt still has two names: 「承認が要る／承認が必要な」 in s3-mode, q3 and card-manual, and 「確認が要る」 in s3-table, pc-mode, e3 and p2-prompt.

The only declared locale (jp) is complete, and there are no images or text baked into images. The one prose link has descriptive text (s3-mode 「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」). Plain-text fields (checklist labels, captions, askTutor suggestions) contain no markdown.

niceToHave: s3-check q3: option a nearly repeats s3-mode, so a learner can pick it by matching words. Have it describe the consequence instead. Set md to 「`npm test` が実行されないまま終わり、テスト結果のない要約が返る」 and keep the explanation; option c (「…止まったままになる」) stays the contrasting distractor.

parallel section title 「1. 並列の3つの方法を選び分ける」 and the s1-table column 「方法（まとめる人）」: the audit verdict for s1-lead notes that the docs count worktrees and background bash as supporting tools, not ways to run agents. For consistency with the fixed s1-lead, consider 「1. 並列の作業を助ける3つの道具を選び分ける」 (ja-editor decides the wording).

s2-steps ex-commit: the facts file says that by default (worktree.baseRef "fresh") a new worktree branches from the remote's default branch, falling back to local HEAD only when there is no remote. In a real repository, local commits that are not pushed will be missing from the worktree. Consider adding 「リモートがあれば、その既定のブランチが起点です。」, cutting an equal amount elsewhere, because est is already 20.0.

s2-steps ex-feature 「別フォルダー・別ブランチなので、変更がぶつかりません」: learners may read this as 'merges never conflict'. Consider 「編集中の変更がぶつかりません」 so it is clear that two branches touching the same lines can still conflict at merge time.

unattended-where: s4-table's caption 「動かす場所と場面で選ぶ」 promises a choice that nothing assesses or practises. Either make the caption descriptive (e.g. 「4つの置き場所と、向いている場面」) or, if est allows, add one inline question under o3 (e.g. 「パソコンを閉じている夜間に毎日動かしたい」 → クラウドの定期タスク, with feedback on `/loop` 「開いているセッションの中でしか動きません」).
Use one term for the permission prompt: 「承認が要る／承認が必要な」 (s3-mode, q3, card-manual) versus 「確認が要る」 (s3-table, pc-mode, e3, p2-prompt). The ja-editor decides which.
s3-table `--permission-mode` `dontAsk` row: 「付けないと、モードは設定しだい」 leaves open why `dontAsk` is needed when `-p` already starts in Manual. Consider 「付けないと、設定ファイルの既定モードが使われることがある」.

p1-steps-write p-run: p-project has already said 「1件成功・1件失敗」, so predicting the result is trivial. A more useful prediction: what happens if `--allowedTools` is removed (ties back to q3). Run once with it and once without.
s2-map sits between the worked steps and their check (s2-check) and splits attention. Consider moving it after s1-cost.

o3 is bloom create, but its graded items are analyze and evaluate (q4, e5, e6); only the self-checked practice 2 asks the learner to design. This is acceptable for multiple choice. If you want tighter alignment, give e5 a short stem that asks which missing line the learner would add, or set o3's bloom to evaluate.

s2-check q2-b (「ワークツリーの中では、テストを実行できない」) and s4-check q4-c (cost cap) are weak distractors that nobody is likely to believe. Consider q2-b 「`.worktreeinclude` がないので、テストのファイルがコピーされていない」 with feedback 「`.worktreeinclude` は `.env` のようなGitの管理外のファイルを写す仕組みです。テストのファイルはGitが管理しているので、ワークツリーにもあります。」 (only if est allows; this adds a term).
summary: I did a full review: review-scope.mjs exited 1 because 27 of 42 blocks (64%) and 41% of the lesson's parts changed since sha256:24be3d570c30f448. Both round-1 must-fix items are fixed: q1 now uses a new context (login text plus payment config), and the worked example can be done in the empty practice repo. Validate shows 0 errors, lint --strict 0 warnings, and measure.mjs reports prose 1583 and est 20.0. No must-fix remains. The most useful remaining improvement is making q3's and q4's correct options state a consequence instead of echoing the sentence just read.
